# Account request: the longest a ticket takes

File: `account.ringi` (the request `account`, version 1, sha256:39468e4aef93e938).

Kept by the team Information Systems (`it`).

The organization is read in each of its versions: from 2026-04-01 and 2027-04-01.

## The longest a ticket takes

A ticket of this request ends within 55 business days at the most:

| What | Business days |
|---|---|
| The longest path of the route, 3 times: once, and again each time it is sent back | 3 × 15 |
| With the requester, to submit it again, 2 times | 2 × 5 |
| In all | 55 |

## The longest path

Every stage comes, those with a condition too.

| Stage | Who answers | Deadline | When it is late | Business days at the most |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| manager | manager | 2 business days, at the end of the day | goes up to the head above, then expires | 5 |
| owner | system_owner | 2 business days, at the end of the day | goes up to the head above, then expires | 5 |
| security | security | 2 business days, at the end of the day | goes up to the head above, then expires | 5 |

One round of this path takes 15 business days at the most.
